headlines.title_en: Cui Dongshu: China's auto market to remain stable in 2026
headlines.summary_en: July 11 (Jin10 Data) — Cui Dongshu, Secretary-General of the China Passenger Car Association, stated that China's macro economy maintains relatively strong growth. Driven by the national consumption promotion policy, the auto market shows robust growth, with the overall national auto market trend in 2026 remaining relatively stable, and a notable recovery in the truck and bus markets supported by high subsidies for production materials. In 2026, the commercial vehicle market exhibits structural growth driven by equipment update subsidies, with newly implemented high subsidies for commercial vehicles accelerating logistics and transportation electrification, leading to high commercial vehicle prosperity. Due to extremely strong consumption policy support last year, policy tightening is evident in 2026, with a sharp decline in support policies for entry-level consumption, resulting in sustained negative growth in passenger car retail sales from January to June this year, especially a collapse in fuel-powered passenger car sales. However, driven by export growth, manufacturer sales growth in June remained relatively stable. New energy vehicles showed weak performance in June, while auto export markets continued to strengthen.

headlines.summary: 7月10日，中国人民银行举办专题讲座，中国人民银行党委书记、行长潘功胜出席并主持讲座。清华大学国家金融研究院院长、国际货币基金组织（IMF）前副总裁朱民以“国际货币体系演变——理论与实践”为题，围绕国际货币体系发展进程、货币国际化衡量标准、数字货币发展等问题，介绍了研究成果和建设性思考，并与现场参加人员进行了交流。

headlines.title_en: PBOC holds special lecture
headlines.summary_en: On July 10, the People's Bank of China held a special lecture, attended and chaired by PBOC Secretary and Governor Pan Gongsheng. Zhu Min, Dean of the Institute of National Financial Research at Tsinghua University and former Vice President of the IMF, gave a lecture titled 'Evolution of the International Monetary System: Theory and Practice,' covering research results and constructive thoughts on the development of the international monetary system, criteria for currency internationalization, and the progress of digital currencies, followed by exchanges with participants.

headlines.title: 美伊战火重燃致霍尔木兹过境量骤降，船东谨慎撤离推高运输成本
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月11日讯，本周美伊战火重燃以来，霍尔木兹海峡过境量明显下降。据Kpler数据，周四过境量从前一日的30艘降至22艘。当地时间周二，伊朗瞄准海峡船只（包括一艘卡塔尔LNG运输船受损）后双方冲突再度爆发。Kpler数据显示，自周二双方互袭以来，仅有两艘LNG船进入海峡，一艘驶出。6月17日美伊签署协议开启结束冲突谈判后过境量曾有所增加，数日后达峰值，随后停火被打破。船运经纪公司Braemar LNG周五在客户报告中称，船东持谨慎态度，已从该地区撤出可用运力，“直至地缘政治局势更加明朗”。此举减少了可用船只数量，推高了运输成本。

headlines.title_en: Renewed US-Iran tensions slash Hormuz transit volumes, shipowners cautious pull-out drives up transport costs
headlines.summary_en: July 11 (Jin10 Data) — Since the renewed conflict between the US and Iran this week, transit volume through the Strait of Hormuz has declined significantly. According to Kpler data, transit volume on Thursday dropped to 22 vessels from 30 the previous day. On Tuesday local time, conflicts escalated after Iran targeted vessels in the strait, including damage to a Qatari LNG carrier. Kpler data shows that since the mutual attacks began on Tuesday, only two LNG vessels entered the strait, while one departed. Transit volume had increased after the US-Iran agreement on June 17 to begin conflict-ending negotiations, peaking a few days later before the ceasefire broke down. Shipping brokerage Braemar LNG stated in a client report Friday that shipowners are cautious and have withdrawn available capacity from the region, 'until the geopolitical situation becomes clearer.' This move reduces the number of available vessels, pushing up transportation costs.

headlines.summary: 金十数据7月11日讯，受强台风“巴威”影响，我国东部沿海部分地区发生强降雨天气，引发严重险情灾情。国家防汛抗旱总指挥部对福建、浙江启动国家防汛防台风二级应急响应。为深入贯彻落实习近平总书记关于防汛救灾工作的重要指示精神，近日，财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨4000万元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持福建、浙江开展防汛防台应急抢险救灾工作，重点做好受灾人员紧急转移避险、排危除险等应急处置、开展次生灾害隐患排查和应急整治等，最大限度减少灾害损失和人员伤亡，切实保障人民群众生命财产安全。

headlines.title_en: Two ministries allocate 40 million yuan in central disaster relief funds to support Fujian and Zhejiang in emergency response to Typhoon Bavi
headlines.summary_en: July 11 (Jin10 Data) — Affected by strong Typhoon Bavi, some eastern coastal areas of China experienced heavy rainfall, triggering severe disasters and emergencies. The State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters activated a Level II emergency response for flood and typhoon prevention in Fujian and Zhejiang provinces. To thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on flood prevention and disaster relief, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management recently pre-allocated 40 million yuan of central natural disaster relief funds to support Fujian and Zhejiang in flood and typhoon prevention emergency response and disaster relief operations, focusing on emergency evacuation and transfer of affected people, hazard removal and emergency treatment, conducting secondary disaster hazard inspections and emergency remediation, to minimize disaster losses and casualties, and ensure the safety of people's lives and property.

headlines.title: 券商业绩迎高光时刻，最高预增693.5%
headlines.summary: 7月刚过10天，已有9家上市券商发布2026年半年度业绩预告，无一例外实现高增长，招商证券等更是直言经营业绩已创历史新高。具体来看，从绝对值计，中信证券、国泰海通双双净利润超200亿元；从增幅计，天风证券以最高693.5%的增幅领跑。更为亮眼的是，多家券商在第二季度实现业绩爆发，5家单季净利增幅翻倍。非银分析师研判，随着财报陆续披露，市场对2026年证券业务的预期差有望逐步修复，券商板块估值修复空间显著。（券商中国）

headlines.title_en: Securities industry earnings shine, with some seeing up to a 693.5% surge.
headlines.summary_en: Just 10 days into July, 9 listed brokerages have released 2026 H1 earnings pre-announcements, all reporting high growth without exception. China Merchants Securities stated outright that operating results hit a record high. In absolute terms, CITIC Securities and Guotai Haitong both posted net profits exceeding RMB 20 billion. In growth terms, Tianfeng Securities led with a maximum increase of 693.5%. More notably, several brokerages saw Q2 earnings surge, with 5 posting single-quarter net profit growth of over 100%. Non-bank analysts suggest that as financial reports are gradually disclosed, market expectations for 2026 securities business are likely to be incrementally revised. The valuation recovery space for the broker sector is significant. (Securities China)

headlines.title: 电科院实控人套现715万入籍加拿大 股价近2月跌掉三分之一
headlines.summary: 7月10日盘后，电科院公告称，公司控股股东、实际控制人胡醇于2026年7月8日完成加拿大国籍入籍手续，个人身份信息由“中国”变更为“加拿大”。其直接持有公司股份248474691股，占总股本比例33.17%。 值得一提的是，电科院7月8日公告，胡醇通过集中竞价交易方式，于2026年4月9日至2026年7月8日期间减持公司股份749100股，减持均价为9.555元/股，以此计算，套现约715万元。公司股价近两个月跌幅达33%。
